propositions: Residual live prose uses of 'Success Criteria' vocabulary must be migrated to 'Acceptance Criteria' in completion.py, test_completion_verifier.py, and sample-ticket-log.jsonl.

A deterministic guard script must scan the repository case-insensitively for 'Success Criteria', 'success criteria', and bare 'SC'/'SCs' tokens with defined path scope and exclusions, enforcing count-pinned allowlist rows.
The guard must fail on count mismatch, malformed allowlist entries, duplicate paths, absent paths, and stale entries, while accepting exact phrase matches only at documented pinned counts.
The root Makefile lint target must wire the guard to run locally and in CI, causing injection of deprecated vocabulary to fail lint validation.
Four permanent semantic carve-outs in experiment language, reviewer markdown, and generated guide must be preserved and allowlisted with non-vacuous counts.
Frozen migration artifacts, Jira captures, and behavioral test probes must remain byte-stable and accepted only at their exact documented occurrence counts.
